# Proof-obligation ledger

| ID | Obligation | Status | Evidence or blocker |
|---|---|---|---|
| D1 | Type every field of the representation package | Proved as a definition | Main Section 3; Appendix A |
| P1 | Show identities and associative composition of heterogeneous profiles | Proved | Appendix B expands the pullback-dependent modulus |
| L1 | Infer spectral support from a positive Laplace bound | Proved | Spectral theorem argument in Appendix C |
| T1 | Transport a common decay rate through indexed recovery | Proved | L1 plus density of the centered core |

| X2 | Show positive finite gaps may collapse | Exact counterexample | Direct-limit diagonal generators with gap `1/n` |
| X3 | Show pointwise recovery need not be uniform | Exact counterexample | Array `d(n,L)=1[L>n]` |
| YM1 | Construct nontrivial continuum Schwinger functions for 4D pure Yang--Mills | Open | Clay existence component |
| YM2 | Prove full-measure physical decay with constants uniform in cutoff and volume | Open | Infrared basin-entry/frontier estimate |
| YM3 | Establish OS positivity and a dense gauge-invariant continuum core | Open | Reconstruction and observable-completeness theorem |
| YM4 | Identify the reconstructed theory as regulator-independent pure Yang--Mills | Open | Universality and theory-identity theorem |

The supplement certifies only the finite countermodels and profile arithmetic.
It is not a proof leaf for T1, whose proof is analytic.
